title: Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition with Bidirectional Audio--Text Cross-Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.26868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are subtle behavioural states that can be expressed through both what a person says and how it is spoken. This paper presents an audio--text framework for video-level A/H recognition. Full-video transcripts and speech waveforms are encoded using pre-trained multilingual BERT and wav2vec~2.0, respectively, and projected into a shared representation space. Two stacked bidirectional cross-attention blocks allow linguistic tokens to attend to acoustic frames and acoustic frames to attend to linguistic context without requiring explicit temporal alignment. The resulting sequences are aggregated through masked mean pooling and combined using concatenation, element-wise products, and absolute differences for binary classification. We evaluate the model on the subject-independent split of the Behavioural Ambivalence/Hesitancy (BAH) dataset. The proposed system achieves 72.19\% accuracy, 75.00\% precision, 81.13\%

translated_title: 基于双向音频-文本交叉注意力的多模态矛盾与犹豫识别
translated_abstract: 矛盾与犹豫（A/H）是一种微妙的行为状态，可以通过一个人说了什么以及说话的方式来表达。本文提出了一个用于视频级A/H识别的音频-文本框架。完整视频的文本转录和语音波形分别使用预训练的多语言BERT和wav2vec 2.0进行编码，并投影到共享表示空间中。两个堆叠的双向交叉注意力模块使语言标记能够关注声学帧，同时声学帧也能关注语言上下文，而无需显式的时间对齐。得到的序列通过掩码平均池化进行聚合，并使用拼接、逐元素乘积和绝对差进行组合以进行二分类。我们在行为矛盾/犹豫（BAH）数据集的受试者独立划分上对该模型进行了评估。所提出的系统达到了72.19%的准确率、75.00%的精确率、81.13%的……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于双向音频-文本交叉注意力的多模态框架，融合多语言BERT和wav2vec 2.0的表征，在无需显式时间对齐的情况下识别视频中的矛盾与犹豫状态，在BAH数据集上达到72.19%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bidirectional audio-text cross-attention framework that fuses multilingual BERT and wav2vec 2.0 representations to recognize ambivalence and hesitancy at the video level without explicit temporal alignment, achieving 72.19% accuracy on the BAH dataset.
